_help: Edit constants, activity levels, METs and info-popup text here. No code changes needed.

activityLevels.name: Extra active
activityLevels.description: Very hard training or a highly active occupation

bmr.title: BMR
bmr.meaning: Basal Metabolic Rate is the number of calories your body burns every day just to stay alive.
bmr.formula:
BMR = 10 × weight (kg) + 6.25 × height (cm) − 5 × age (years) + 5 for male, − 161 for female
(Mifflin-St Jeor)

tdee.title: TDEE
tdee.meaning: Total Daily Energy Expenditure is the total number of calories a person burns throughout the day, including their resting metabolism, daily movement, exercise, and digestion.
tdee.formula:
TDEE = BMR × Activity factor

Shown as a reference. Final TDEE uses the 1.2 factor plus your logged exercise, because your activity level already includes exercise.

burn.title: Calories burned by activity
burn.meaning: Calories burned in one session of an activity.

finalTdee.title: Final TDEE
finalTdee.meaning: Your daily energy expenditure including your planned workouts.
finalTdee.formula:
Final TDEE = BMR × 1.2 + Daily burn

1.2 covers resting needs plus everyday living. Your logged exercise is added on top, so workouts are not counted twice.

deficit.title: Daily deficit
deficit.meaning: Calories you burn beyond what you eat each day.

weeklyDeficit.title: Weekly deficit
weeklyDeficit.meaning: Daily deficit over a full week.

weeklyLoss.title: Weekly weight loss
weeklyLoss.meaning: Estimated fat loss per week. 1 kg of fat ≈ 7700 kcal.

timeToGoal.title: Time to goal
timeToGoal.meaning: Estimated time to reach your target weight.
timeToGoal.formula: Days = (Current kg − Target kg) × 7700 ÷ Daily deficit

steps.title: Steps
steps.meaning: Calories burned by walking, using a fixed rate per step.

activityAvg.title: Average daily burn
activityAvg.meaning: Calories burned by your planned activities, averaged over a week.
activityAvg.formula:
Avg daily = Σ (kcal per session × days per week) ÷ 7
Weekly = Avg daily × 7
Session kcal = MET × 3.5 × weight (kg) ÷ 200 × minutes

eatingAvg.title: Daily eating
eatingAvg.meaning: Calories and protein from the foods you have ticked, for one typical day.
eatingAvg.formula:
Daily eating = Σ food kcal (ticked rows)
Weekly = Daily × 7
Food kcal = kcal per serving × (qty × unit size ÷ serving size)
